title: WIT-02 Strategy Template v1
$comment: Canonical machine schema for the WIT-02 strategy template (WIT-02 §6; WIT-03 §4 owns this file, WIT-02 owns the semantics). RECONCILIATION (WIT-02 §2 vs §6): §2 describes A2 (claimed_performance) and A3 (internal_consistency_flags) as fields that carry the performance claims and the internal contradictions. §6 also defines top-level arrays `claims[]` and `consistency_flags[]`. Per this prompt, §6 wins for STRUCTURE: A2/A3 remain field objects (status/value/source_quote/assumption like every other field), but the machine-readable rows live in the top-level `claims[]` and `consistency_flags[]` arrays. FIELD COUNT: WIT-02 §2's header says '25 fields' but its field tables enumerate 27 IDs (A1-A3, B1-B3, C1-C3, D1-D4, E1, F1-F5, G1-G2, H1-H2, I1, J1-J2, K1). This schema includes all 27 that §2 defines — the tables are authoritative for the field set.

template_version.description: semver-major on breaking field changes (WIT-02 §6). v1 = '1.0'.

fields.description: All 27 template fields A1..K1 (WIT-02 §2). Every field is a field object.

claims.description: Every performance assertion (WIT-02 A2/§4.3). Structured home per §6.

consistency_flags.description: Contradictions within the source (WIT-02 A3/§4.4). Structured home per §6.

interpretations.description: Reasonable alternate readings of ambiguous rules (WIT-02 J2/§4.5).

value.description: Extracted content, or null. Any JSON type (string is typical).

status.description: WIT-02 §1: specified (stated) | implied (inferred, quote required) | unspecified.

source_quote.description: Verbatim transcript snippet; mandatory (non-null) for specified/implied (WIT-02 §4.1).

assumption.description: If unspecified and required, the §5 default applied. Otherwise null.
